declaration.ref: hand-written for kit-pr-watch against pr-watch-report-v1 and pr-watch-work-v1; no field is copied from a stored watch, a runner log or a real pull request

report-unchanged.json.proves: a look that finds nothing new reports the head it saw and clears the last error with null

report-first-look.json.proves: a first look records the reviewed commit and where that baseline came from

report-review-started.json.proves: starting a review names the session and the commit it reviews

report-review-posted.json.proves: a posted review links to the review on github.com

report-review-failed.json.proves: a failed session needs only its finish time, with the reason in error

report-addressed.json.proves: an address pass reports its outcome, a multi-line summary, how far it read the comments, and no link when it pushed nothing

report-merged.json.proves: a merged pull request ends its watch

work-list.json.proves: a failed review watch with Review now pressed, beside an address watch with comments waiting

work-empty.json.proves: an empty queue is an empty list

work-newer-board.json.proves: a board that answers keys this runner does not read yet still matches

report-missing-checked-at.json.reason: every report says when the runner looked

report-unknown-key.json.reason: a report names only the fields the board stores

report-short-head-sha.json.reason: the head is the full 40-character commit

report-posted-off-github.json.reason: a posted review links to github.com, so the queue never links elsewhere

report-unknown-outcome.json.reason: an address pass pushed, changed nothing, or needs the owner

report-unknown-status.json.reason: a watch is watching, stopped, closed or merged

work-unknown-status.json.reason: a watch is watching, stopped, closed or merged

work-missing-kind.json.reason: the runner needs to know whether to review or to address comments
